response.sql: SELECT AVG(CAST(spent AS REAL) / amount) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS line_count FROM budget WHERE spent > 6.0

assumptions.assumption: Ratios are missing when amount is NULL or zero; division by zero returns NULL in SQLite and AVG ignores NULLs, so these are excluded from the average. The line count still counts every budget line with spent > 6.0, including those with a missing ratio.

alternatives.interpretation: Count only the lines that have a valid (non-missing) ratio, so the count matches the lines averaged.
alternatives.sql: SELECT AVG(CAST(spent AS REAL) / amount) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(CAST(spent AS REAL) / amount) AS line_count FROM budget WHERE spent > 6.0
